statement: For the centre-free extension E of every full punctured-torus outer action of order three, exactly two normal index-three subgroups are torsion-free: the specified Fhat2 and an explicitly defined second kernel U. Their intersection V is the full completion of the degree-three torus cover of type (1,3). U is projective, U has maximal pro-three quotient free of rank two, and it contains three explicitly labelled peripheral normalizers which form distinct U-conjugacy classes and are cyclically permuted by E/U. At every other prime q with nonidentity cubic multiplier, the U/V-character multiplicities on H1(V,Qq) are (1,3,0) or (0,2,2), and U's maximal pro-q quotient has rank one or zero respectively.
where_proved: Separate Part D proof note D.51; work/part_c/d51_note.tex
depends_on: D27 actual order-three lift and Serre projectivity theorem; D33 primary homology and exact determinant multiplier; D48 two section classes, Bockstein periodicity, and unit three-adic cusp cube; explicit characteristic Heisenberg quotient and labelled cube formula; exact surface covering and finite-index pro-three topology
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part D(b), full loop-outer finite actions in type (1,1)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Both index-three kernels, the degree-three cover, all three peripheral labels, and the comparison of their homology modules are defined by the actual displayed homomorphisms. The projective group U is not identified with a full free group.
notes: The exact Heisenberg cube polynomial is d*b*(b-b1), where D48 separates the two actual section values 0 and b1. The unit cusp cube makes its value the third element -b1 of F3. Thus psi=chi+b1*u kills the full cusp normalizer and is nonzero on both torsion classes. U=ker psi is torsion-free; V=F intersect U is the exact type-(1,3) cover. The quotient E/V is C3 squared, so U/V fixes each of the three cusp classes and E/U permutes them cyclically. Projectivity and exact induced pro-three topology give U^(3) rank two. Boundary homology contributes two copies of the multiplier character, while the compact covering homology gives the original rank-two matrix, proving the stated bad-prime module patterns. The full group U and its three normalizers are not reconstructed from those local quotients, and the global order-three multiplier and full conjugacy remain unresolved.
